_meta.note: Two hardenings + docs. (1) Fold hb-audit (deterministic) + a refutation into /heartbeat plan's acceptance step, so no DAG is proposed until it audits clean and a skeptic fails to refute it. (2) Extend tests/parity.sh from lint/audit/state to FULL coverage of the shared surfaces: protocol, resolve (next), ready, report, diagnose — node ≡ python. Gate cmds are behavioral; this plan passes hb audit clean.

tasks.title: Add py `hb next` (resolve)
tasks.description: Add an `hb next` subcommand to py/src/heartbeat/cli.py that prints resolver.resolve(state,dag) as JSON, so the resolver is comparable to node hb-next-task.js.

tasks.title: Extend tests/parity.sh
tasks.description: Extend tests/parity.sh to also compare node vs python on: protocol (the reason->action map), next (resolve), ready (the runnable set), report (progress numbers), and diagnose (the inferred blocker). Keep T43 running it in tests/run-tests.sh.

tasks.title: Update the plan acceptance step
tasks.description: Update the /heartbeat plan acceptance block in plugin/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md so it runs hb-audit.js (must be 0 hollow gates) AND spawns a skeptic to refute the DAG (must be SOUND) before proposing — folding concerns back into the DAG. Add a node-suite assertion that the skill documents hb-audit in the plan acceptance.

tasks.title: Docs + version bump
tasks.description: Update README.md, STATUS.md, and planning/parity-notes.md to reflect full-coverage parity and the audited plan step; bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to 1.11.0 and py/pyproject.toml to 0.4.0.

GATE_PF0.desc: Parity covers every shared surface and node ≡ python.

review.prompt: Refute that PF0 is done: does parity ACTUALLY compare protocol, resolve, ready, report AND diagnose — or did it stub some? Are the comparisons meaningful (normalized on semantics) rather than trivially-equal empty strings? Does `hb next` really return the resolver's decision? Would a real divergence between node and python make the test fail?

criteria.desc: parity now covers protocol, next, ready, report, diagnose
criteria.cmd: out=$(bash "$PROJECT_DIR/tests/parity.sh"); for s in protocol next ready report diagnose; do echo "$out" | grep -q "$s" || exit 1; done

criteria.desc: py `hb next` returns the resolver decision
criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import heartbeat.cli as c; import inspect; assert 'next' in inspect.getsource(c.main)"

GATE_PF1.desc: The plan acceptance step audits and refutes before proposing.

criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && awk '/heartbeat plan/{f=1} f&&/hb-audit/{print; found=1} END{exit !found}' plugin/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md

GATE_PF2.desc: Documented and versioned; both suites + parity green.
